_comment: Временная область: ключи из router/luci-app-dpishell/lang-src/web.json (router-work, 0b03435); после слияния router-work заменить встроенным ресурсом того файла.
web.warn.auto_select_failed: Automatic search found no working strategy — the previous one stays
web.warn.dns_fallback: Secure DNS is unavailable — the ISP’s DNS is temporarily in use
web.warn.dns_spoofed: The ISP is spoofing site addresses — apps outside the browser may not work
web.warn.switched_backup: The strategy stopped working — backup {name} is on
web.diag.flow_handed: handed over to optimization — no interference
web.diag.ipv6_bad: present — sites over IPv6 bypass optimization
web.diag.ipv6_on: present, optimization is on for IPv6 too — no interference
web.site.listed: {host} is in the router’s optimization list (“Sites” → “Optimize”).
web.site.not_in_list_hint: “Only from lists” is on: the router leaves sites outside the lists alone.
